title: ILA 201-U – Valuation and Advanced Product and Risk Management, U.S.

topics.title: U.S. Financial Reporting Requirements
topics.objective: The candidate will understand and apply U.S. valuation principles and methods applicable to individual life insurance and annuity products issued by U.S. life insurance companies.

outcomes.text: Describe, apply and evaluate the appropriate valuation methods, requirements, and techniques and related under the US statutory framework, including the calculation of principles-based reserves and formulaic reserves

Describe, apply and evaluate the appropriate valuation methods, requirements, and techniques and related under the US GAAP framework, including the calculation of reserves and related items (e.g., DAC)

resources.citation: Statutory Valuation of Individual Life and Annuity Contracts, Volumes I and II, Claire, D., Lombardi, L. and Summers, S., 5th Edition, 2018

parts.text: Chapter 23: VM-20: PBR for Life Products (excluding 23.1)
Chapter 24: VM 21: PBR for Variable Annuities

resources.citation: US GAAP for Insurers, Freedman, M., and Frasca, R., 3rd Edition, 2024

parts.text: Chapter 1: US GAAP Objectives and their Implications to Insurers

resources.citation: Implementation Considerations for VA Market Risk Benefits, The Financial Reporter, Sep 2019

topics.title: Capital Management
topics.objective: The candidate will understand how to explain and apply the methods, approaches and tools of financial capital management for life insurance company under a US regulatory framework.

outcomes.text: Explain and calculate required capital under a US regulatory framework
Describe the purpose and application of economic capital
Explain and evaluate the respective perspectives of regulators, investors, policyholders and insurance company management regarding the role and determination of capital
Explain and apply methods in capital management

resources.citation: Statutory Valuation of Individual Life and Annuity Contracts, Volume II, Claire, D., Lombardi, L. and Summers, S., 5th Edition, 2018
Economic Capital for Life Insurance Companies, SOA Research Paper, Oct 2016 (Sections 2 & 6)
A Multi-Stakeholder Approach to Capital Adequacy, Conning Research, Actuarial Practice Forum
ILA201-800-25: Theory of Risk Capital in Financial Firms

topics.title: Management and Evaluation of Life Insurance Risks
topics.objective: The candidate will understand types of life insurance risks, the impacts of diversification, crediting rating agency frameworks, and the assessment of risk management.

outcomes.text: Analyze the impact of risk diversification, including considerations for modeling and offsets between mortality and longevity risk
Understand the role and framework used by credit rating agencies for evaluating life insurance companies
Explain and understand the use and application of the Own Risk Solvency Assessment (ORSA) report

resources.citation: ILA201-801-25: Diversification of Longevity and Mortality Risk
ILA201-100-25: Diversification: Consideration on Modelling Aspects & Related Fungibility and Transferability, CRO, Oct 2013, pp. 1-18
Rating Agency Perspectives on Insurance Company Capital, SOA Research Institute, Aug 2023 (excluding Appendices)
ILA201-802-25: NAIC Own Risk and Solvency Assessment (ORSA) Guidance Manual, National Association of Insurance Commissioners, Dec 2017

topics.title: Advanced Product Management
topics.objective: The candidate will understand the fundamentals of value creation and inforce management techniques for life and annuity products.

outcomes.text: Describe and evaluate fundamental strategies for enhancing value and profitability through active in-force and operational management
Recommend and justify changes to non-guaranteed elements and policyholder dividends
Describe, evaluate, and apply the economic value creation framework
Describe and apply the methods and principles of embedded value for an insurance enterprise
Describe and calculate reserves under US Company Tax rules

resources.citation: Evolving Strategies to Improve Inforce Post-Level Term Profitability, Product Matters, Feb 2015, pp. 23-28
ILA201-101-25: Life in-force Management: Improving Consumer Value and Long-Term Profitability
Mechanics of Dividends, SOA Research Institute, Mar 2022
ILA201-102-25: Economics of Insurance: How Insurers Create Value for Shareholders, pp. 4-31
Embedded Value: Practice and Theory, Actuarial Practice Forum, Mar 2009
FAQ on Certain Insurance Reserves Held by Insurance Companies for the Purpose of Determining U.S. Taxable Income after the Passage of the Tax Cuts and Jobs Act of 2017, AAA, Dec 2021
